guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for all properties in a list of ASE atoms objects including info and calculator results
guess_target_metadata: guess whether target samples are per-atom or per-image and whether they are intensive or extensive
target_extensive: check if a property scales with atom count by analyzing per-atom normalized standard deviation
target_per_atom: determine if target samples have a first dimension proportional to the number of atoms
target_constant_shape: check if all target samples share the same shape regardless of atom count
